title: 菜凉了 / 上错了，怎么用英语跟服务员说？
summary: 在美国餐厅遇到菜品问题，直接说出来很正常。这篇教你投诉、换菜、告知过敏的得体说法。

featuredPhrase.en: Excuse me, this isn't what I ordered.
featuredPhrase.zh: 不好意思，这不是我点的。

phrases.en: Excuse me, this isn't what I ordered.
phrases.zh: 不好意思，这不是我点的。

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: Excuse me, this isn't what I ordered. I asked for the grilled chicken.
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，这不是我点的。我要的是烤鸡。

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.en: Oh, I'm so sorry! Let me fix that right away.
dialogue.zh: 啊，太抱歉了！我马上给你换。

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: Also, I'm allergic to shellfish. Can you make sure there's none in it?
dialogue.zh: 还有，我对贝类过敏。能确认里面没有贝类吗？

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.en: Absolutely. I'll tell the kitchen. It'll be about 10 minutes.
dialogue.zh: 当然。我跟厨房说。大概 10 分钟。

seoTitle: 餐厅菜有问题英文怎么说？
seoDescription: 在美国餐厅菜上错了、菜凉了怎么说？本文教你得体投诉和换菜的英语说法，附完整对话。
